citation.authors: Monro J, Mishra S, Stoklosinski H, et al.
citation.title: Dietary Fibre and Organic Acids in Kiwifruit Suppress Glycaemic Response Equally by Delaying Absorption—A Randomised Crossover Human Trial with Parallel Analysis of 13C-Acetate Uptake

population.description: Nine healthy volunteers who completed the crossover (6 women, 3 men; 11 randomised, 2 withdrew), aged 18-40 y: the paper prints only this enrolment range (Table A1 'Age (y) 18–40'), used here as min and max because nothing else about age is given. BMI 25.9 ± 4.5 (SD) kg/m2, range 20.6-32.9 (Table A1). 'Healthy'; screened by history of diabetes and by fasting blood glucose and HbA1c (no glucose tolerance test); fasting glucose 4.7 ± 0.45 mmol/L, HbA1c 32.7 ± 3.5 mmol/mol.

protocols.name: wb_kfsug
protocols.description: Meal 1 (control, no non-sugar kiwifruit components): 30 g Weet-Bix giving 20.1 g available carbohydrate (Section 2.3) plus 20.4 g glucose:fructose:sucrose (2:2:1) dissolved in 200 mL water, 100 mg sodium [1-13C] acetate, water to 252 mL; eaten within 10 min (entered as one meal at minute 0). carbs_g 40.5 = 20.1 + 20.4 (both printed). protein_g 3.6 = 30 g x 12% and fat_g 0.42 = 30 g x 1.4% (Weet-Bix composition by mass, Section 2.1; derived by percent of mass, which is not one of the guide's listed derivations; no other protein or fat in this meal). Fasted from 22:00 the night before (Section 2.4); clock hour of the test not printed (08:00 assumed, so 10 h fast assumed). Samples at -5, 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180 min; arm run to 181 min.

meals.food: Weet-Bix and glucose:fructose:sucrose sugars in water

protocols.name: fasting_screen
protocols.description: Fasting blood glucose of the nine participants (Table A1); the paper says only that a fasting blood sample was taken at the screening visit, not the occasion, clock hour or fast length; a 30-minute run-in stands for the single sample, 08:00 and a 10 h fast are the guide's defaults.

findings.description: Positive incremental area under the capillary blood glucose curve, 0 to 30 min, after WB+KFsug (baseline is the 0 min sample; positive iAUC, Section 2.6)
Positive incremental area under the capillary blood glucose curve, 0 to 180 min, after WB+KFsug (baseline is the 0 min sample; positive iAUC, Section 2.6)
Incremental area under the plasma insulin curve (finger-prick plasma, ELISA), 0 to 30 min, after WB+KFsug (treatment of values under baseline not stated)
Incremental area under the plasma insulin curve (finger-prick plasma, ELISA), 0 to 180 min, after WB+KFsug (treatment of values under baseline not stated)
Fasting blood glucose of the nine participants at screening (Table A1, mean and SD)

location.where: Table A1, row 'Fasting blood glucose, mean ± SD (range) (mmol/L)'

left_out.what: Incremental blood glucose peak height iBGRmax per meal (Table 2, mmol/L, mean and SEM): the mean of each person's own highest rise over baseline
Incremental insulin peak height per meal (Table 3, µU/mL, mean and SEM): the mean of each person's own highest rise over baseline
Percent change versus WB+KFsug columns of Tables 2 and 3 ('Change in Mean (%)') and the ANOVA F, p and letter groupings, Tables 2-6 and A2-A8
Dietary fibre content of the kiwifruit pulp and of the juice (Appendix Figure A1; text gives only 'about 75%' removed in the juice): fibre_g cannot be stated for the kiwifruit arms

Glucose and insulin iAUC at 30 and 180 min (Tables 2 and 3, mean and SEM) of the four meals other than the control: WB+KF (whole pulp, pH 3.3), WB+KFneut (pulp neutralised to pH 7), WB+KFjuice (194 mL low-fibre juice) and WB+KFsug+OA (sugars plus 50 mL organic-acid solution: citric 2.35 g, malic 0.63 g, ascorbic 0.17 g). All five meals have the same carbohydrate, protein and fat grams, and the model can be told neither the cell-wall fibre (amount not printed in text), the organic acids nor the pH, so each would be the control's meal with a different target (iAUC30 23.4 to 34.0 against 46.9); the control arm alone is entered
Time-courses of incremental blood glucose and insulin at -5 to 180 min (Figure 1A and 1B; error bars on two curves only); glycaemic fluctuation / hypoglycaemic overshoot at about 75 min (Figure 5)
Breath 13CO2 time to peak, 13C iAUC (Tables 4, 5, A7) and the sodium [1-13C] acetate absorption marker
Visual analogue scale appetite areas (hunger, fullness, satisfaction, quantity; Table 6)
HbA1c of the nine participants, 32.7 +/- 3.5 mmol/mol (Table A1)
